name: sqlcraft-studio
description: Plataforma Interactiva de Práctica SQL con Evaluador Automático

scripts.build: powershell -Command "Remove-Item -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue dist; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path dist | Out-Null; Copy-Item index.html dist/; Copy-Item _headers dist/ -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Copy-Item tienda.db dist/; Copy-Item -Recurse components dist/; Copy-Item -Recurse css dist/; Copy-Item -Recurse js dist/"
scripts.deploy: npm run build && wrangler pages deploy dist --project-name sqlcraft-studio --branch main
